scenes.setting: Cleanup: touching the tainted black eye shows the world laced with black threads; Miss Bodyguard sinks into Rosago's headless corpse, regrows a cracked-glass head, scours the scene spotless, and walks the body out into the night
scenes.text_anchor: She slowly sank in and fused with the corpse!

scenes.setting: Alone on the sofa, adrenaline draining: a coin toss — 'Bakerland is already dead' — lands heads. Positive. The whole affair is finally over
scenes.text_anchor: Klein fished out a coin and, with recited with a suppressed tone, “Bakerland is already dead.”

scenes.setting: The embassy: two military officials read the corpse — disease, isolation, flesh-blood magic, an obliterating blow — and reach the same word at once: Shepherd. The Aurora Order will take the blame
scenes.text_anchor: two military officials were squatting beside Bakerland's body

scenes.setting: The bodyguard reappears in the oriel window: clothes handled; she will collect the 900 pounds herself — and, contract-abiding to a fault, insists on protecting him the full three days, name withheld
scenes.text_anchor: “I promised to protect you for three days, not just once.”
